summary: First-finish smoke test on SkillSwap. Backend: auth (register/login admin+user), exchange lifecycle (create, accept via PATCH, complete), messaging, reviews, notifications, admin stats, and negative-path guards (self-request 400, chat-before-accept 400, review-before-complete 400, non-admin hitting /api/admin/stats 403) all pass. Frontend: landing loads, auth guard redirects /dashboard to /login, user login lands on /dashboard with stats cards, /discover shows Priya and excludes admin, /requests shows tabs, admin login lands on /admin with correct live stats (Users=4, Exchanges=1, Messages=1, Reviews=1, Completed=1). Data-testids present and functional.
passed: POST /api/messages before accept -> 400 'Exchange not accepted yet'
POST /api/reviews before complete -> 400 'Complete the exchange first'
POST /api/messages after accept -> 200 (and GET /api/messages/{id} returns list)
Notifications auto-created for both parties (recipient=3, requester=2 after full lifecycle)
Frontend landing page loads with hero-cta-signup
User login redirects to /dashboard with stats cards (Skills Taught, Avg Rating visible)
/discover shows other user (Priya) and excludes admin
Admin login redirects to /admin and shows admin-stat-users card with live count
notes: Backend contract uses to_user_id / text / PATCH /api/exchanges/{id} for status (frontend already aligned per code review). Chat polling UI, notification bell unread count, admin delete user, and review-rendering on profile were not explicitly clicked in FE (deferred to full test), but underlying APIs verified end-to-end.
